value.rationale: A canonical family of graph independence complexes has previously known nonequivariant four-sphere homotopy for all multiples of five, but that leaves nontrivial 4-dimensional symmetry structure undetermined. The complete dihedral character gives an intrinsic parity-dependent sign twist for even n, exact traces on every rotation/reflection, and rational acyclicity of the full orbit space, revealing information invisible from Betti numbers. The family and symmetry invariant are structurally motivated rather than arbitrary numerical slices.
